description.zh:
备份计划ID。

> 请填入本参数BackupPlanId或RestoreTaskId。
description.en:
The ID of the backup plan.

> You must specify either this parameter or `RestoreTaskId`.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.
The end of the time range to query restore tasks. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. The timestamp is a millisecond-level timestamp.

description.zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为：0。
description.en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0.

description.zh:
每页的记录数，取值为1~100。

> 默认为30。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

> The default value is 30.

description.zh:
恢复任务ID，支持多个查询，使用半角逗号（,）分隔。您可以调用[CreateRestoreTask](~~2869836~~)接口获取该参数。

> 请填入本参数RestoreTaskId或BackupPlanId，同时填入时会导致报错。
description.en:
The ID of the restore task. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas. You can call the [CreateRestoreTask](~~2869836~~) operation to obtain the restore task ID.

> You must specify either this parameter or `BackupPlanId`. Specifying both parameters returns an error.
The beginning of the time range to query restore tasks. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. The timestamp is a millisecond-level timestamp.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs describe-restore-task-list --backup-plan-id dbs1hvb0wwwXXXXX --restore-task-id s102h7rf5anq --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --start-timestamp 1570701361528 --end-timestamp 1570701361528 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs DescribeRestoreTaskList --region cn-hangzhou --RestoreTaskId s102h7rf5anq --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --StartTimestamp 1570701361528 --BackupPlanId dbs1hvb0wwwXXXXX --EndTimestamp 1570701361528 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx
